content.title: CBSE 10th Toppers List 2026 (Out); District-wise Toppers Name & Marks
content.text: CBSE 10th top performers list 2026 has been released along with the CBSE 10th result 2026. CBSE does not release toppers. The decision not to release the toppers' list was taken to avoid unhealthy competition among students. CBSE 10th result 2026 will be released soon. Read here for more details.CBSE 10th top performers list 2026 has been released along with the CBSE 10th result 2026 on April 15 at around 4 pm. CBSE does not release toppers. The decision not to release the toppers' list was taken to avoid unhealthy competition among students. Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) announced CBSE 10th result 2026 on April 15 at around 4 pm at cbse.gov.in. Along with the result, the board released the list of top performers. As per the board’s policy since 2020, CBSE does not release toppers list. The decision not to release the toppers' list was taken to avoid unhealthy competition among students. Students can check their CBSE Class 10 result 2026 by logging with the required details on the board's website at cbseresults.nic.in. This year, overall pass percentage stands at 93.70%. Girls have outshined boys with a pass percentage of 94.99%, while boys have secured a pass percentage of 92.6%. The CBSE 10th 2026 exam was conducted from February 17 to March 11. Read below for more details on CBSE 10th Toppers List 2026. CBSE does not release Class 10 toppers list. This process intends to reduce undue academic pressure and avoid unhealthy competition among students. Though CBSE does not declare the topper's list, the board issues merit certificates to the top 0.1% of students in each subject. Students can check CBSE 10th result 2026 on cbse.gov.in, DigiLocker, and UMANG.
